rationale: The macOS darwin-arm64 release SDK leg now configures with the pulp-vellum editor bridge on, using the Vellum SDK archive pinned and digest-verified in pulp.lock. It adds a post-install assertion that the staged SDK has the bridge headers, library and Pulp::vellum target, and makes pulp create --ui vellum refuse an installed SDK without that target. This packages an existing integration; it adds no design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority and changes no importer or renderer behaviour.
